sections.title: Attacks and defenses mechanics
lines: Grounded bite · The bat must land, often on the victim, to bite. The usual bite deals 1d2 damage. The more powerful 1 HD variety makes up 10% of Giant Bats and bites for 1d4.
Missile defense · While flying, the bat gains a +3 Armor Class bonus against missile attacks from opponents with Dexterity 13 or less.

sections.title: Bite disease rules mechanics
lines: Rabies in AD&D · A bite has a 1% chance per point of damage to cause disease. The printed game rule uses a 1d4+6 day onset and a ten-day survival window after onset. An afflicted character cannot eat or drink. If provoked, a failed Wisdom check makes them attack until killed or knocked unconscious. The entry allows cure disease, wish, limited wish, alter reality, or similar magic to cure it.
